---
title: Orecchiette with Mussels
id: MAR-0088
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g orecchiette
- 800 g mussels
- 1 dl tomato sauce
- 1 garlic clove
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 2 tablespoons fresh oregano
- 1 chili peppers
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Scrub the mussels under running water, remove the beard, collect them in a saucepan, cover and let them open over medium-high heat; it will take 5 minutes.
2. Filter the liquid that has formed and shell the mussels except for about ten of the fullest ones.
3. Crush the garlic and peel it.
4. Cut the chili pepper lengthwise.
5. Heat the oil in a pan and sauté the garlic and chili pepper for 5 minutes; remove them, pour in the tomato sauce and the mussel liquid, stir and cook for about 10 minutes.
6. Add the shelled mussels and the oregano and turn off the heat.
7. Meanwhile, cook the orecchiette in plenty of salted water, drain them, pour them into the pan, mix and serve on plates, finishing with the remaining mussels.
